_comment: Tier-2 for febio::fluid#1. <y_dof> inside a 'zero fluid velocity' BC gives 'tag "y_dof" (line N) : unrecognized tag'; a deliberately invented <qq_dof> gives the same message with only the tag name changed. The fixture parses both messages and requires the non-name part to be equal — that equality is the claim, because it is what tells you the diagnostic will never hint at the w prefix. Positive control: the shipped template, unmodified, which reaches normal termination — so the message is attributable to the single thing that was changed. Executed 2026-08-06 on FEBio 4.12.0.86045466d (source build, USE_MKL=OFF). MUTATION CONTROL (2026-08-07): T2_MUTATE=1 neutralises the L.swap / L.drop edits this fixture uses to turn a correct deck into a broken one, so every deck it builds is the correct one and the pitfall is never triggered. Unmutated the fixture still PASSES; mutated it FAILS because the expectation 'fluid_dof_prefix=reproduced' is no longer printed and the forbidden token 'not_reproduced' appears. Re-verify with `cd <fixture dir> && T2_MUTATE=1 ~/Schreibtisch/open-fem-agent/.venv/bin/python source.py` (the mutation branch lives in source.py, so the proof is one command and needs no external harness).
